name: Saint Timothy
contribution: An early Christian evangelist and the first Bishop of Ephesus, whom the Acts of Timothy relates died around AD 97.

checks.lead: Timothy (Greek: Τιμόθεος, Timótheos, meaning "honouring God" or "honoured by God") was an early Christian evangelist and the first Bishop of Ephesus, whom the Acts of Timothy relates died around AD 97.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
